## About
Sylvan Springs Automotive is a locally owned and operated repair shop on Telegraph Road in St. Louis. From basic oil changes to major transmission work, we handle the everyday maintenance and the bigger repairs that keep your car or truck on the road.
Our ASE-certified mechanics pay attention to detail, and we like to explain what your vehicle needs so you can take care of it for years. We use top brand name parts and fluids, and there's a convenience store right here at the shop.
One reviewer recommends us to anyone in the South County/South City area. Give us a call at (314) 845-1866 or stop by.

## Services
- Oil and filter service: Oil and filter changes, plus checks on washer fluid, coolant and transmission fluid.
- Transmission repairs: Transmission repairs for cars, trucks, vans and SUVs.
- Brakes, engines and front end work: Repairs on brakes, engines, clutches, exhaust systems, cooling systems, belts and hoses, alternators and fuel pumps.
- Computer diagnostics: Computer diagnostics and electronic testing to track down the problem.
- Emissions inspections: One reviewer said they got their emissions inspection right away.
- Pick up, delivery and towing: Call us for details on getting your vehicle to and from the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Can you tow my car to the shop?
A: Yes. We offer pick up, delivery and towing. Call us for details.

Q: What if you don't have the part my car needs?
A: We can order it, and we generally expect it the same day.

Q: Is there a store at the shop?
A: Yes. We run a convenience store alongside the repair shop.
